<translated_code>
import sys

mod = 1000000007
N = 0
K = 0

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, n, m=None):
        if m is None:
            m = n
        self.A = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
        self.n = n
        self.m = m

    def height(self):
        return self.n

    def width(self):
        return self.m

    def __getitem__(self, k):
        return self.A[k]

    def __setitem__(self, k, val):
        self.A[k] = val

    @classmethod
    def I(cls, n):
        mat = cls(n)
        for i in range(n):
            mat[i][i] = 1
        return mat

    def __iadd__(self, B):
        n, m = self.n, self.m
        assert n == B.n and m == B.m
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self[i][j] = (self[i][j] + B[i][j]) % mod
        return self

    def __isub__(self, B):
        n, m = self.n, self.m
        assert n == B.n and m == B.m
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                self[i][j] = (self[i][j] - B[i][j] + mod) % mod
        return self

    def __imul__(self, B):
        n, m, p = self.n, B.m, self.m
        assert p == B.n
        C = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(m):
                s = 0
                for k in range(p):
                    s = (s + self[i][k] * B[k][j]) % mod
                C[i][j] = s
        self.A = C
        self.m = m
        return self

    def __ipow__(self, k):
        B = Matrix.I(self.n)
        while k > 0:
            if k & 1:
                B *= self
            self *= self
            k >>= 1
        self.A = B.A
        self.m = B.m
        return self

    def __add__(self, B):
        res = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        res.A = [row[:] for row in self.A]
        res += B
        return res

    def __sub__(self, B):
        res = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        res.A = [row[:] for row in self.A]
        res -= B
        return res

    def __mul__(self, B):
        res = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        res.A = [row[:] for row in self.A]
        res *= B
        return res

    def __pow__(self, k):
        res = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        res.A = [row[:] for row in self.A]
        res **= k
        return res

    def determinant(self):
        B = Matrix(self.n, self.m)
        B.A = [row[:] for row in self.A]
        assert B.n == B.m
        ret = 1
        for i in range(B.n):
            idx = -1
            for j in range(i, B.n):
                if B[j][i] != 0:
                    idx = j
                    break
            if idx == -1:
                return 0
            if i != idx:
                ret = (-ret) % mod
                B[i], B[idx] = B[idx], B[i]
            ret = (ret * B[i][i]) % mod
            vv = B[i][i]
            inv_vv = pow(vv, mod - 2, mod)
            for j in range(B.n):
                B[i][j] = (B[i][j] * inv_vv) % mod
            for j in range(i + 1, B.n):
                a = B[j][i]
                for k in range(B.n):
                    B[j][k] = (B[j][k] - B[i][k] * a) % mod
        return ret

    def rot(self):
        global K
        n = self.n
        B = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(K):
            for j in range(K):
                B[i][j] = self.A[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K]
            B[i][K] = self.A[(i + K - 1) % K][K]
            B[K][i] = self.A[K][(i + K - 1) % K]
        B[K][K] = self.A[K][K]
        self.A = B

    def __repr__(self):
        s = ""
        for i in range(self.n):
            s += "[" + ",".join(str(self[i][j]) for j in range(self.m)) + "]\n"
        return s


def main():
    global N, K, mod
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    N = int(input_data[0])
    K = int(input_data[1])

    INDEX = 0
    copy = N
    while copy >= K:
        INDEX += 1
        copy //= K

    mat = [[None] * K for _ in range(INDEX + 1)]

    mat[0][0] = Matrix.I(K + 1)
    for i in range(1, K + 1):
        mat[0][0][0][i] = 1

    for i in range(1, K):
        mat[0][i] = Matrix(K + 1, K + 1)
        mat[0][i].A = [row[:] for row in mat[0][i - 1].A]
        mat[0][i].rot()

    for index in range(1, INDEX + 1):
        mat[index][0] = Matrix(K + 1, K + 1)
        mat[index][0].A = [row[:] for row in mat[index - 1][0].A]
        for i in range(1, K):
            mat[index][0] = mat[index - 1][i] * mat[index][0]
        for i in range(1, K):
            mat[index][i] = Matrix(K + 1, K + 1)
            mat[index][i].A = [row[:] for row in mat[index][i - 1].A]
            mat[index][i].rot()

    ans = Matrix(K + 1, 1)
    ans[K][0] = 1
    used = 0
    while INDEX >= 0:
        while True:
            power = pow(K, INDEX)
            if power <= N:
                N -= power
                ans = mat[INDEX][used] * ans
                used = (used + 1) % K
            else:
                break
        INDEX -= 1

    val = sum(ans[i][0] for i in range(K + 1)) % mod
    print(val)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
